_metadata.description: One node-agent cross-compiled for linux/darwin/windows; platform-native service install; no Linux-only assumptions.

requirements.title: Cross-Platform Node-Agent
requirements.description: One node-agent codebase is cross-compiled for Linux, macOS, and Windows and installs itself as the platform-native background service (systemd / launchd / Windows Service or Scheduled Task). The agent uses platform path/process abstractions only, with no Linux-only assumptions, so a node can be any of the three OSes from day one.

validation.notes: Service-install adapter selects systemd/launchd/Windows-Service by service-manager kind (mirrors NativeServiceManager(GOOS)); rendered units carry no hardcoded POSIX paths and the privileged helper installs under a separate OS principal.
Agent cross-compiles cleanly CGO_ENABLED=0 for all six targets: linux/darwin/windows × amd64/arm64.
The agent runs as a background service on at least one real macOS and one real Windows node.
